weapon_formulas.melee_max: max0 + level * tier (or max0 if broken)
weapon_formulas.excess_str_bonus: Random.IntRange(0, hero.STR - weapon.STR) added to damage
weapon_formulas.random_generation: 40% chance: 1-3 upgrade levels; 50% upgraded / 50% degraded+cursed; 1-in-(10+level) enchantment chance

melee_weapons.name: ShortSword
melee_weapons.notes: STR hardcoded to 11 (not 10). Has REFORGE action: consumes self to upgrade another melee weapon when level > 0

melee_weapons.name: WarHammer
melee_weapons.notes: 20% more accurate, slightly less max damage than Glaive

missile_weapons.name: IncendiaryDart
missile_weapons.effect: Sets target on fire (Burning). Ignites flammable tiles on miss

missile_weapons.name: Tomahawk
missile_weapons.effect: Causes Bleeding equal to damage dealt

types.name: Fire

types.name: Poison
types.label: venomous %s

types.name: Death
types.label: grim %s
types.effect: Instant kill: deals defender.HP damage

types.name: Paralysis
types.label: stunning %s
types.effect: Paralyzes for Random.Float(1, 1.5+level) turns

types.name: Leech
types.label: vampiric %s
types.effect: Heals Random.IntRange(0, damage*(level+2)/(level+6)), capped at missing HP. 33%/43%/50% effective at lvl 0/1/2

types.name: Slow
types.label: chilling %s
types.effect: Slows for Random.Float(1, 1.5+level) turns

types.name: Shock

types.effect: Random.Int(1, damage/2) lightning damage. Chains to adjacent, halving each jump. 2x in water

types.name: Instability

types.effect: Re-rolls damage level+1 extra times, takes highest. Excess dealt as bonus

types.name: Tempering

types.effect: Restores weapon durability on every hit

types.name: Bounce
types.label: %s of bounce
types.effect: Pushes attacker back 1 tile

types.name: Affection
types.label: %s of affection
types.effect: Charms attacker 3-7 turns, defender 50-100% of that duration. Level capped at 6

types.name: AntiEntropy
types.label: %s of anti-entropy
types.effect: Freezes attacker (Frost), sets defender on fire (Burning)

types.name: Multiplicity
types.label: %s of multiplicity
types.effect: Spawns MirrorImage. Costs Random.IntRange(1, defender.HT/6) HP from defender

types.name: Potential
types.label: %s of potential
types.effect: Deals Random.IntRange(1, damage) lightning to attacker, then Random.IntRange(1, that) to defender

types.name: Metabolism

types.effect: Heals Random.Int(1, defender.HT/5) at cost of STARVING/10 hunger

types.name: Stench

types.effect: Seeds 20 volume ToxicGas at attacker position

types.name: Viscosity

types.effect: Converts all damage to deferred (1 HP/turn)

types.name: Displacement

types.effect: Teleports defender to random visible tile. (level+1)*5 placement tries. Does NOT work on boss levels

types.name: Entanglement
